## Summary
Implements **P15.5** (`docs/tickets/P15.5__corrections-methodology.md`) — the last Phase-15 public surfaces, on P15.1's epistemic visual language and no-JS/a11y/archivability baseline (§§39.7, 39.8, 41). Implementation is `web/` (TypeScript confined there, SIG-ENG-010). Stacked on P15.4.

- **Research queue** (SIG-UI-031, §33): task cards state the closing condition, evidence sought, assignee class, effort estimate; geographic filtering (§33.5); claiming as **priority-not-exclusivity** with expiry (SIG-TASK-010/011); the full disposition vocabulary incl. **"searched, found nothing"** derived by assignee class (SIG-TASK-008/009); no volume leaderboard (SIG-TASK-012).
- **Public corrections log** (SIG-UI-032) — the required **eighth surface**: what changed / when / why / who reported it, the outcome (correct/annotate/suppress/delete/refuse), a belief-pinned permalink to the prior value (SIG-GOV-005), and a transparency report incl. refusals (SIG-GOV-011).
- **Dispute/correction path** (SIG-UI-033, §45.1): one click from any claim on every page via the base layout; five intake categories with privacy/safety prioritized above all and no forced identity except a legal demand (SIG-GOV-001/002/003).
- **Methodology + data-freshness (§32.4) + coverage-metrics (§32.5)** pages (SIG-UI-034), linked from every dossier via the every-page module. Coverage enforces **"never a total"** structurally (named denominator required, population total unrepresentable, no capture–recapture kind — SIG-METRIC-008/009/010).
- **"How we know this"** module on **every page** with all six components (SIG-UI-044).
- **Editorial standards**: six register rules (SIG-UI-043) in a public style guide, applied to **generated rationale** too (SIG-UI-046); the three example cases as the spec's exact copy (SIG-UI-045); the recorded **hostile-reader review** committed with the template version, **release blocked at build** until every finding is dispositioned (SIG-UI-042).
- **Cross-surface assertion**: the seven outline surfaces + the corrections log exist across the built site.

## What changed
- New libs: `research-queue.ts`, `corrections.ts`, `provenance.ts`, `metrics.ts`, `editorial.ts` + `corrections-methodology-fixture.ts`.
- New components: `HowWeKnowThis.astro`, `DisputeLink.astro`, wired into `BaseLayout.astro` (every page) + expanded nav.
- New pages: research-queue, corrections, dispute, methodology, data-freshness, coverage-metrics, editorial-standards, style-guide.
- Docs: **ADR-053**, `docs/governance/hostile-reader-review-dossier.md`, traceability + risk-register (RISK-P15-27..32) updates.
- Tests: 5 new unit suites + `corrections-methodology.spec.ts` / `.nojs.spec.ts`; new pages added to the a11y sweep; seven-surfaces manifest.

## Design decisions
- Every surface is **pure colour-free logic + committed fixtures + a static page**; field names mirror the engine vocabularies so wiring to live data is a source swap (static-first, SIG-UI-036).
- The hard "must nots" are made **executable build gates**: coverage "never a total" (`assertCoverageMetric`), register conformance on generated text (`assertRegisterConformant`), and the hostile-reader release block (`assertReviewReleasable`).
- Per-page invariants (SIG-UI-044 module, SIG-UI-033 dispute link, SIG-UI-034 links) live in the **base layout**, so they hold on every current and future page/dossier structurally.
